cases.title: Analyst, Growth Analytics
cases.text: Position Overview Join our Business Analytics team , where data meets creativity to drive smarter media decisions. As the Analyst , you’ll collaborate with internal teams, external partners, and data providers to transform insights into action — actively contributing to optimizing media investments and shaping strategy across digital and traditional channels. In this role, you’ll dive deep into the evolving world of digital and media ecosystems , gaining experience with broad range of analytics: Data tracking challenges with cookies and SDKs Website tagging and measurement strategies The impact of walled gardens on analytics TV and out-of-home (OOH) attribution models You’ll gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge analytics tools and methodologies, helping to build a foundation in media measurement, attribution, and optimization . This opportunity is designed to launch your career in media analytics , connecting you with a brand that’s woven into America’s DNA. Why This Role Stands Out This hybrid position blends media analytics with web analytics , offering exposure to multiple specialties across the analytics landscape. You’ll have access to mentorship, professional development, and real-world projects that accelerate your growth. If you’re curious, analytical, and eager to learn, this role opens doors to a dynamic career in data-driven marketing. Responsibilities Develop an understanding of client’s industry, business objectives and strategy, media plans, and consumer journey to provide context for analysis and reporting needs Data Extraction, Transformation & Loading (ETL), Quality & Hygiene Coordinate with technical teams to ensure accurate and comprehensive web analytics implementation and tracking across web properties. Provide insight into site visitor behaviour and engagement to identify optimization opportunities across websites to help inform site design changes. Apply independent critical thinking to analyse vast data sets to uncover media insights (what’s working, what’s not working) to drive strategic decisions. Participate in brainstorming sessions with communication planners, creative assets, media planners, buyers, clients and other partner agencies Contribute to the department’s overall capabilities and understanding of media and communications channels Work with Director and senior analysts to develop report content (Word, Excel, Tableau, Looker, PowerPoint) in support of ongoing deliverables, as well as ad hoc reporting Required Skills and Experience Must possess strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills Highly motivated and collaborative team player with strong interpersonal skills Expertise in Microsoft Excel, PowerPointand Word Experience working with large datasets to uncover insights that are essential to business optimizations is a plus Desired Skills and Experience 1+ years of experience in a professional services or corporate environment Experience using data visualization tools, such as: Excel 365, Tableau or Snowflake preferred Experience with ad-serving platforms such as Google Campaign Manager is a plus Experience with web analytics tools such as Google Analytics and/or Adobe Analytics, and/or tag management tools such as DTM/Launch, GTM and Tealium also a plus Wage and Benefits We offer a Total Rewards package that includes medical and dental coverage, 401(k) plans, flex spending, life insurance, disability, employee discount program, employee stock purchase program and paid family benefits to support you and your family. cases.title: Associate Director, Business Analytics
locations: New York, New York, United States
cases.text: Business Overview IPG Mediabrands is the media and marketing solutions division of Interpublic Group (NYSE: IPG). IPG Mediabrands manages over $47 billion in marketing investment globally on behalf of its clients across its full-service agency networks UM, Initiative and Mediahub and through its award-winning specialty business units Healix , Kinesso , MAGNA , Mediabrands Content Studio, Orion Holdings, Rapport, and the IPG Media Lab. IPG Mediabrands clients include many of the world’s most recognizable and iconic brands from a broad portfolio of industry sectors including automotive, personal finance, consumer product goods (CPG), pharma, health and wellness, entertainment, financial services, energy, toys and gaming, direct to consumer and e-commerce, retail, hospitality, food and beverage, fashion and beauty. The company employs more than 18,000 diverse marketing communication professionals in more than 130 countries. Learn more at www.ipgmediabrands.com . Position Summary The Associate Director, Business Analytics — HCP & DTC Client Solutions will support the leadership of analytics, measurement, and accountability initiatives for a major healthcare client across both HCP and DTC / patient media programs. This role combines strong analytical thinking, client partnership, operational leadership, and strategic storytelling to help evolve analytics from descriptive reporting toward proactive decision support. cases.title: Manager, Data Management & Visualization
locations: New York, New York, United States
cases.text: Position Summary The Manager, Data Management & Visualization, is responsible for guiding the development, oversight, and execution of data-driven solutions and business intelligence across marketing and media activities. This role acts as a strategic link among Digital Media, Marketing Sciences, and offshore technology teams—ensuring optimized campaign delivery and performance through all phases of campaign management. The ideal candidate combines technical acumen, an eye for process automation and data governance, and strong organizational and leadership skills, consistently driving innovation and operational excellence for internal teams and external clients. Responsibilities Strategic Data Leadership : Develop, implement, and maintain scalable data strategies, technical solutions, and data governance processes to address unique business challenges and account objectives. Team & Stakeholder Collaboration : Serve as the liaison among internal digital, marketing science, analytics, investment teams, offshore resources, and external partners to ensure cohesive data integration, campaign tracking, and project alignment. Project & Process Management : Manage projects from requirements definition to completion, ensuring clear communication, timely delivery, and resolution of roadblocks through project management best practices and platforms. Data Operations & Quality Assurance : Oversee the integrity and quality of data generated throughout campaign delivery and optimization lifecycles. Lead efforts in data harmonization, cleansing, QA, and reconciliation to ensure flawless performance tracking and reporting. Campaign Oversight : Provide oversight of digital media buys and data flows, ensuring processes are followed and all activities meet organizational and industry standards across programmatic, digital, search, social, and offline media channels. Innovation & Automation : Drive adoption of the latest data operations methodologies and leverage automation to increase efficiency and data accuracy within operational processes. Mentorship & Leadership : Provide guidance and oversight to team members, promote a collaborative and positive team environment, and champion continuous learning and professional development. Required Skills & Experience 3-5 years’ experience in data operations and/or business intelligence 1-3 years’ experience in an advertising agency environment (analytics, ad operations, marketing sciences, digital investment, business analysis preferred) 3-5 years’ experience in digital media data (ad server, search, social, video, offline, etc.), data governance, and quality processes in data warehousing or ETL environments 2+ years’ experience in client-facing roles and managing project teams (including offshore is a plus) In-depth knowledge of processes across multiple media channels; comfort with diverse dataset types (paid, owned, etc.) Familiarity with campaign management and performance optimization processes Strong attention to detail and ability to identify and resolve data anomalies Advanced verbal, written, organizational, and project management skills; comfortable juggling multiple priorities Excellent collaboration and interpersonal skills with a proactive approach to problem-solving Experience in process automation/continuous improvement initiatives TOOLS Business Intelligence: Advanced Excel (required), Tableau, PowerBI, Datorama, Looker/Looker Studio, Domo, PowerPoint Data Management & Transformation : ETL Tools ( Adverity , Datorama), Alteryx, SQL (preferred), Python (nice to have) Data Storage/Cloud: AWS ( Redshift, S3 ) , Starburst.io, Datorama, Snowflake, Domo M edia Platforms: DCM, DV360, Google Ads, DoubleVerify , IAS, TradeDesk , Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, Twitter, TikTok, Prisma Project Management: HIVE, Asana, Smartsheet, Microsoft Teams Media Planning: MediaTools , Lumina, Hudson (bonus) Wage and Benefits We offer a Total Rewards package that includes medical and dental coverage, 401(k) plans, flex spending, life insurance, disability, employee discount program, employee stock purchase program and paid family benefits to support you and your family. .
